body: Ang overlooked novelty dito: hindi lang future payments ang puwedeng ma-save. Sabi mismo ng Japan Pension Service, qualifying premiums na nabayaran na can be credited or refunded after filing, at parehong spouses can qualify separately kung pareho silang Category 1 at pasok sa conditions. So worth checking even kung naka-autopay na at hindi naagapan ang first qualifying month—hindi automatic na lost opportunity iyon.
